text:
Taylor (AE): Velos asks for a one-off hosted API key for Friday's demo. Requirements: inference-only, office IP allowlist, TTL 6h, ability to rotate mid-demo, and an auditable revoke. Can someone create and vault it? @Nadia pls.
Nadia (Solutions Engineer): I can. Create under org velo-42, scope inference:generate only. Confirm IPs?
Taylor (AE): Yes: 52.12.34.10/32 and 52.12.34.11/32. No embeddings or uploads.
Ravi (Infra): Ops notes: max TTL 24h, we prefer 6h for demos. Add tags: poc=velos, sensitivity=ephemeral. Disable console preview for secret. Schedule auto-revoke at T+7h as safety.
Nadia (Solutions Engineer): Creating via admin API. Snippet (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"velo-42","name":"velos-demo-ephemeral","scopes":["inference:generate"],"allowed_ips":["52.12.34.10/32","52.12.34.11/32"],"ttl_hours":6,"tags":["poc:velos","sensitivity:ephemeral"],"no_console":true}'
```
I will vault the secret in 1Password and post the link here. Revoke command (for SRE/PS):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys/REPLACE_KEY_ID/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
security-bot: policy_check passed: ip_bind enforced, ttl_within_limit, no_console=true
Nadia (Solutions Engineer): Key created: key_id=kr_05Zxy9. Secret vaulted: https://1password.company/velos/kr_05Zxy9 (access: sales@redwood,se@redwood). Auto-revoke scheduled at 2391241490 (T+7h).
Ravi (Infra): Scheduled auto-revoke and audit logging. If they need mid-demo rotation: Sales pings SE->SRE, SE creates replacement key with TTL 2h and we swap; SRE revokes old after verification. Add rotation justification in vault.
Taylor (AE): Thanks. I'll share the vault link with Velos ops and confirm in-thread when demo ends.
Nadia (Solutions Engineer): Please confirm revoke when demo done and I'll revoke manually early if asked.
security-bot: audit_log: action=provision key_id=kr_05Zxy9 created_by=nadia_se ip_bind=[52.12.34.10/32,52.12.34.11/32] ttl=6h tags=[poc:velos,sensitivity:ephemeral] no_console=true
Taylor (AE): Closing loop  confirm when revoked pls.
Nadia (Solutions Engineer): Revoked at 2391238200 via API. key_id=kr_05Zxy9 revoked_by=nadia_se reason=demo_end. Vault item removed.
security-bot: audit_log: action=revoke key_id=kr_05Zxy9 revoked_at=2391238200 revoked_by=nadia_se reason=demo_end
